text:
alex: heads-up — alerting across hosted-api in us-west-2: 5xx rate jumped ~3x right after a staged deploy at 13:05. 502/504s mostly. customers hitting errors and timeouts. @maya_sre can you take initial triage?

maya_sre: on it. I see a routing change shipped in the seed rollout that adds a routing-tag header. sudden spike in upstream gateway timeouts and gateway 502s in the traces. digging into envoy logs now.

lina_runtime: pulling traces — a LOT of requests getting short-circuited at the api-router with: `upstream reset before response`. also seeing increased kv-cache miss amplification during the same interval.

jake_support: incoming from support: two enterprise customers reported repeated 502s during bulk embedding runs and a spike in retries causing billing noise. they've attached request ids.

alex: repro steps from support would help. can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces?

jake_support: here's the curl they're using:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Routing-Tag: blue-seed-v2" -d '{"input":"long batch..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

lina_runtime: aha — routing tag header triggers new route matrix. the new route variant routes to a model variant that expects a different kv cache key shape. the mismatch can cause the runtime to attempt a fallback population and block for db reads — we probably didn't account for that in the canary.

maya_sre: env logs show the following repeated pattern: `error=upstream request canceled: context deadline exceeded` and `500 upstream: request timed out waiting for response`. timing correlates with the rollout start at 13:05.

alex: any config flip that would affect request sizes or timeouts?

lina_runtime: yes — the staged roll included a smaller per-request soft-timeout for that seed variant (was lowered to 1.2s to favor latency), which combined with the heavier db fallback made the upstream frequently miss. effectively we created a path that times out faster.

cam_product: this started from a routing experiment to steer prefetched cache to a new route — we thought it was safe but looks like we missed the kv shape change. we need to rollback the seed ASAP. customers complaining and billing errors piling up.

maya_sre: recommendation: immediate rollback of that routing-tag rollout, increase soft-timeout back to previous value, and then run a small synthetic load that mirrors customer bulk embedding. I'll prepare the rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: deploy status: rollback initiated for rollout-id=roll-2026-09-seedA by maya_sre at 13:28 UTC. 60% traffic -> previous revision in 5m increments.

alex: @lina_runtime please prepare a patch: ensure kv cache key compat shim and add guard that prevents lowering soft-timeout for routes that trigger fallback db reads. Also add telemetry for request header shapes.

lina_runtime: will do. quick mitigation: patching the router to ignore `X-Routing-Tag` for model variants that have no kv-prefix mapping until we finish the shim. pushing a quick fix to the router config.

incidents-bot: alerting update: 5xx rate decreasing — currently 65% of peak. rollback at 13:28 is progressing.

jake_support: I told the affected customers we're rolling back and will follow up with a post-mortem and credit for retries. one customer asked if this could cause data loss for in-progress batches — clarified: retries may have duplicated billing events, no model/state loss.

maya_sre: post-rollback checks: 1) confirm 5xx back to baseline for the last 15m 2) verify no new error classes like 401 from truncated auth headers 3) sanity-check billing events for duplicate charges.

lina_runtime: rollback finished at 13:34 UTC. router change reverted and router ignore rule in place. running synthetic bulk embedding tests now. initial results: no 502s in 1000 requests.

alex: good. maya — can you coordinate with billing ops to identify duplicate invoice events for customers who retried in the 13:05-13:34 window?

maya_sre: looping in billing ops separately. jake — can you collect the request ids and customer traces and attach them to the incident ticket? we'll include them in the post-mortem.

jake_support: on it. compiling req ids and short repro steps, will upload to the ticket and ping customers with next steps.

cam_product: action items for product/eng: 1) stop using new routing-tag header for seeded rollouts until kv-shim + tests are in 2) add rollout safety check that disallows reducing soft-timeout while enabling route fallback paths 3) expand canary traffic matrix to include bulk embedding client patterns.

lina_runtime: I'll open an RFC and a follow-up PR with the kv-shim, router ignore rule, and a unit harness that simulates bulk embedding latency.

incidents-bot: incident update: status=resolved (traffic reverted) at 13:36 UTC, summary=Staged routing tag caused kv-cache mismatch + lower soft-timeouts -> upstream timeouts and 5xx spike. follow-up actions assigned.

alex: thanks everyone. we'll run a short post-mortem and notify SRE/Support/Product mailing lists. great coordination. :thumbsup:
